title: The Maharashtra Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Boards Act, 1965
full_text: The Maharashtra Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Boards Act, 1965 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196541 Act Number: 41 Enactment Date: 1965-09-13 Act Year: 1965 Short Title: The Maharashtra Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Boards Act, 1965 Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment of a State Board and Divisional Boards to regulate certain matters pertaining to secondary (and higher secondary) education in the State of Maharashtra.
